startup.failure: EngineCore reported worker RuntimeError: CUDA error: out of memory; worker process died during startup/warmup.
startup.manualStopAndCleanup: systemd --user stopped only q85-hyperqwen-canary.service; wrapper printed Q85_CANDIDATE_SERVER_STOPPED; container removed by its Compose down cleanup; port 18142 free afterward.

diagnosticEvidence: Container startup log said TP=2 was sizing KV from GPU_UTIL=0.93 because KV_MEM was unset.
The boot log warned hybrid KV group padding could waste up to 60% of cache memory.
Pinned HyperQwen docs state TP>1 skips the single-card KV pin by default and recommend fixing KV_MEM before measuring; this is a plausible, not proven, contributor.
The GPU memory asymmetry and missing full traceback prevent assigning a definitive root cause to the KV pool or to one worker/rank.

logRetention.reason: The first runner removed the Compose container before saving its logs; only a sampled tail and journal status remain in the interactive run history.
logRetention.correctiveChange: Runner now detects worker/CUDA OOM from recent logs and writes a redacted, mode-0600 log receipt before Compose cleanup.

decision: Canary failed before inference. No quality, correctness, TPS, or adoption claim. Tool-Eval remains blocked until a newly preregistered startup and canary attempt passes.
